quotes.author: Melinda H
quotes.text: The Best Charter Ever! Capt Chet is the best! My three sisters and I went for a cruise around Sarasota Bay on Capt Chet’s very comfortable catamaran power boat. We saw beautiful homes, and lots of local wildlife, including many bird species (we even had a couple of Bald Eagles fly overhead!), Manatees and Dolphins. We brought our own snacks and “favorite” beverage (he will also cruise you to local restaurants if you’d like). We had a lovely time! We will definitely charter with Capt Chet when we return to Sarasota. Thanks Chet!

quotes.author: Mary Ann W
quotes.text: Great Family Fun We had to reschedule our morning cruise several times because of Hurrican Debbie. Captain Chet was most amenable to all of the changes. We took tour of the local bays and passes around our hometown and learned a lot. The Captain let each of our grandchildren take a turn at the wheel, which they really enjoyed. Due to the runoffs from the storm we weren't able to stop and get into the water. ruiseWe will definitely try this on our next time!

quotes.author: Ellen B
quotes.text: Birthdays celebrated on Cap. Chet’s boat while visiting Sarasota Boating in the Gulf Stream with cap. Chet My husband and dear friend both were celebrating birthdays, both love boating and adventures. What better than an amazing boat trip on this immaculate boat, clean fluffy blankets, animals during mating season and perfect weather. We also got to c the Ringling estate from the water . Could not have been more perfect

quotes.author: Kate C
quotes.text: Best. Day. Ever. Our 4 hour trip with Captain Chet was amazing! He gave us many options for our time, which ended up including wildlife viewing, snorkeling and some time on a beautiful beach. We even had dolphins playing and jumping in the wake of his boat, things dreams are made of! Our day on his boat the best day of our vacation, our only regret is not booking a full day. Book it!!

quotes.author: Mark
quotes.text: Sarasota Boat Charter. Captain Chet. This is the BEST private charter in Sarasota. I'm a local and I have used Captain Chet four times. He's professional, affordable, knowledgeable and FUN! His boat is clean and has plenty of space. He has a BATHROOM on board. This charter is for relaxing, cruising and beach time. This is not a fishing charter. See you again soon, Captain Chet!

quotes.author: Carolyn
quotes.text: Great way to celebrate! We celebrated my husband's birthday with a sunset cruise with Capt. Chet, and it was fabulous. Chet is easy to work with, very knowledgeable about boating (and safety) and the Sarasota Bay area. He was easy-going, and conversational. When we have guests in town, we'll definitely call Island Time Charter to take us out on another cruise.
